content.text: {"notes":["The requested readout time is absolute t=1.0 s; joint angles are unwrapped and expressed in radians in each joint’s local frame, with angular velocities in rad/s.","The tip position is a three-component world-frame vector in meters; the world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up.","Both joints receive a constant applied torque of -0.4316572123351727 N·m, and joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m during the scheduled interval [0.5623, 0.6623) s.","joint_limit_by_T is true if either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by the requested time; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
